snippet.title: Night Jackal: Blood Debt - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Unleash brutal justice as Night Jackal, a masked vigilante driven to the edge after a violent assault on his manor leaves his world shattered. All signs point to his arch-nemesis, the elusive Burt the Barbarous—but is there a deeper conspiracy afoot?

Built in Easy FPS Editor, this bite-sized boomer shooter throws you into a retro-fueled rampage of precision firepower, relentless enemies, and a protagonist hell-bent on settling his blood debt!

Brains Meet Bullets: Balance raw gunplay with stealth, puzzles, underwater mechanics, and more.

Story-Driven Mayhem: Experience this original story of a super hero coming unhinged.

Original Artwork: Featuring visuals pulled from the Night Jackal comic, including work by industry veteran Derec Donovan (Spider-Man, Superman, Wonder Woman).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620560/Night_Jackal_Blood_Debt/
